_comment: Thresholds for tools/distinct.py, so the numbers live in the repo rather than in somebody's memory. Copy this, set your own values, and pass it with --policy.
_copy_max: Max fraction of 8-word phrases two sites may share. Blocking.
_network: The set is a deliberate family, so also check it coheres.
_cohesion_min: Min structural overlap for the set to read as one network.
_formula_max: Max sites that may share one headline shape. Blocking.
